Directed by Amal Sheela Thamby, this lighthearted family comedy tackles the complexities of fatherhood through Avaraachan's experiences. The film also features Sreenath Bhasi and Ganapathy, promising a heartwarming narrative. Expect its arrival on this OTT platform after the theatrical release, with ETimes giving it a 2.5-star rating for its ups and downs.

title: Macklemore begins ‘Free Palestine’ tour in Dublin - WATCH
description: Rapper Macklemore has begun his 'Free Palestine' tour in Dublin, highlighting his commitment to Palestinian freedom. He faced controversy after being dropped from Ed Sheeran's tour for his political statements. During the concert, he emphasized a message of love and shared humanity regarding the Palestinian cause. Hozier and other guests also participated by addressing urgent issues faced by students from Gaza.

title: Udta Teer BO: First Monday drops to Rs 2.71 crore
description: ‘Udta Teer’ box office collection day 4: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan’s spy comedy earned an estimated Rs 2.71 crore net on its first Monday, a 67% drop from Sunday. After Rs 4.10 crore, Rs 7.25 crore and Rs 8.20 crore over the weekend, its India total stands at Rs 22.26 crore, per Sacnilk.

title: 'Titans' BO day 5: Jayasurya and Vinayakan's film earns Rs 21 lakh
description: Jayasurya and Vinayakan's latest venture, 'Titans', is experiencing a drastic box office dip. With earnings of only Rs 21 lakh on Monday, the total domestic net revenue stands at Rs 2.16 crore after five days of release. Although the film kickstarted with promising viewer interest, it has swiftly lost traction this week. Set against a backdrop of crime and mystery, 'Titans' delves into a heist narrative in Fort Kochi.

title: 'Ranabaali' BO day 11: Vijay Deverakonda's film earns Rs 1.25 cr
description: Ranabaali's box office earnings dropped to Rs 1.25 crore on Monday after a strong weekend performance. The film's total domestic gross has reached Rs 63.05 crores, despite Monday's decline in revenue. Its overseas and worldwide collections have also been reported, showing significant ticket sales overall. Meanwhile, Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's team has reported online harassment and misinformation to Cyber Crime police.

title: 'Jailer 2' BO day 12: Rajinikanth's film earns Rs 9.45 cr on Monday
description: Rajinikanth's film 'Jailer 2' saw a significant decline in box office collections on its second Monday. The movie earned Rs 9.45 crore, a 63.2% drop compared to Sunday. Its domestic gross has crossed Rs 400 crore, with worldwide earnings at Rs 733.35 crore. The film's strongest performance came during the second weekend, collecting Rs 25.70 crore on Sunday.

title: ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ postponed in India? Clash with 'Ramayana' averted
description: The box office competition between 'Godzilla Minus Zero' and 'Ramayana' has been postponed due to scheduling conflicts. Reports indicate that 'Godzilla Minus Zero' may be delayed because of limited IMAX screen availability. 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' is set to release alongside it, also targeting IMAX formats. Distribution plans for 'Godzilla Minus Zero' are under consideration, but no official announcements have been made yet.

title: ‘All My Children’ actor Alan Dysert passes away at 75
description: Alan Dysert, recognized for his role in the soap opera 'All My Children', has passed away at the age of 75. His wife Michele confirmed his death, noting he had struggled with cancer for over a decade. Dysert chronicled his health challenges in his memoir titled 'Lights, Camera, Cancer!'. He was not just an actor but also a producer, director, and educator in the acting community.

title: Ben Affleck on Netflix’s $587 million AI deal, Hollywood job fears
description: Ben Affleck has opened up about selling his AI filmmaking company InterPositive to Netflix in a reported $587 million deal. The actor explains why Hollywood should not panic about artificial intelligence replacing jobs, sharing how his technology aims to help filmmakers retain creative control. He also dismisses fears of AI taking over humanity while cautioning against its unchecked use.

title: Chris Brown avoids jail in London over 2023 nightclub bottle attack
description: Chris Brown has avoided immediate jail in London after admitting affray over a 2023 nightclub bottle attack on music producer Abraham Diaw. The singer received an eight-month suspended prison sentence, with the judge stressing the seriousness of the assault. Brown’s guilty plea, recent conduct and apology were considered during sentencing.

title: Akshay's 'Mohra' to hit big screens again after 32 years, to clash with 'Ramayana' at box office
description: Returning to the silver screen, Mohra, the iconic film from 1994, is set to enchant audiences once again in a beautifully remastered version. Premiering just a day after the release of Ramayana, this classic features a star-studded cast including Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty, and Raveena Tandon. Famed for its unforgettable soundtrack filled with numerous hit songs, Mohra remains one of 1994’s highest-grossing films, celebrated for its cinematic excellence.

title: 'Star Trek' actor Walter Koenig, who played Ensign Pavel Chekov, passes away at 90
description: Walter Koenig, famous for his role as Ensign Pavel Chekov in 'Star Trek', has died at age 90. His agent confirmed that he passed away at his home in North Hollywood, surrounded by family. Koenig portrayed Chekov from 1966 to 1969, contributing significantly to the show's enduring legacy. He appeared in seven films and wrote a book titled 'Chekov’s Enterprise' in 1980.

title: Daler Mehendi did kirtans in Gurudwara before making it big in the industry, revealed Mika
description: Mika Singh has come forward to support his brother Daler Mehndi after an unfortunate episode that occurred at an event in Uttarakhand, capturing considerable media scrutiny. The singing duo shares a profound musical legacy from their father's kirtan singing, which led to the establishment of their group, Maharaja Band. In light of the situation, Uttarakhand's Minister Subodh Uniyal has expressed regret to Daler in a phone conversation.

title: Tiger Shroff firing case: Football Club suspends Sunday sessions after incident
description: Following a disturbing shooting incident on October 18, All Stars Football Club in Mumbai has suspended its Sunday football sessions. Founder Bunty Walia announced that activities would only resume once enhancements in security protocols are established. The unsettling situation arose as actor Tiger Shroff exited a practice session at Pushpa Park. Initial investigations revealed that Aamir Khan was apparently the original target.

Eager anticipation surrounds this potential project, which would also unite Kriti and Varun for the third time. Their previous individual projects added to the excitement for this cinematic reunion.

title: Anthropic sued over alleged use of 274 Elvis Presley songs to train AI models
description: Anthropic faces a lawsuit for allegedly misusing 274 Elvis Presley songs to train its AI systems. Rights holders led by Authentic Brands Group claim the company didn't seek permission or provide compensation for using their copyrighted content. They argue that the AI's outputs closely resemble the original songs, raising serious copyright concerns. This case underscores the ongoing legal dilemmas confronting AI firms regarding artistic and creative properties.

title: Tiger Shroff firing case: Court sends four accused to police custody till October 28
description: In a significant development, a Mumbai court has ordered the police custody of four suspects tied to the Tiger Shroff firing incident until October 28. While police seek to obtain voice samples, the defense contends that enough evidence is already in hand, questioning the necessity of extended detention. The public prosecutor highlighted the ongoing danger posed by additional suspects still unapprehended outside Maharashtra.
